messages:
harper: Incident follow-up: we need a short (90m) export of auth events to reproduce a replay bug. Window: 2026-08-14T03:15:00Z -> 2026-08-14T04:45:00Z. Requesting approvals for a masked, timeboxed export.
lee: tag me. what's the PII surface? emails, user_ids, full IPs?
harper: user_ids and emails appear in some events, plus device_ip. Plan: user_id -> sha256(user_id + SALT), email -> redact, ip -> mask /24, drop auth_token. Deliver via ephemeral HSM-backed KMS URL, pre-signed for 3h, snapshot auto-deletes in 48h.
kms-ops: policy check: ephemeral HSM key requires ticket and auditor signoff. Key expiry and decrypt principals must be explicit.
oncall-jane: i'm oncall for the window; i'll do MFA unwrap. approve conditional on SALT in vault and audit hooks for grant/decrypt/download/delete.
auditor-ali: require SALT stored at vault://sec/INC-4999/salt, per-export audit_reason field, and that the role for export be resource-scoped. Also need a per-export salt rotation after deletion.
infra-ron: we'll create a resource-scoped role "incident-exporter/INC-4999" and a short-lived principal. I'll open an infra PR and include reviewers @sre @seceng. Also will wire the pre-signed download flow so nothing persists to long-term buckets.
harper: SIEM query (approx): "service=auth AND ts=\"2026-08-14T03:15:00Z\" AND ts=\"2026-08-14T04:45:00Z\" | fields user_id,email,device_ip,event,timestamp". Scrub rules: user_id->sha256+SALT, email->"[redacted]", ip->mask_last_octet, remove oauth_token.
infra-ron: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/3322 - adds role, lifecycle lambda, and download flow. please review.
kms-ops: KMS request KMS-1788 filed for ephemeral HSM key with expiry 6h. Key policy will restrict Decrypt to the role ARN and oncall-Jane ARN. awaiting ops approval.
auditor-ali: once KMS-1788 shows key_policy restricting Decrypt and SALT is in vault, i can sign off. Ensure audit event fields include grant_by, grant_reason, unwrap_by, unwrap_mfa, and deletion_time.
oncall-jane: add me to the unwrap principals. include exact curl/aws commands in the ticket so i can follow them verbatim.
lee: small ask: please ensure the infra PR narrows SIEM permissions to the export resource only (no siem:*). lint should catch broad permissions.
harper: ticket INC-4999 created and SALT stored at vault://sec/INC-4999/salt. kicking off checks.
security-bot: runbook checklist: ticket created, SALT in vault, infra PR, KMS request, auditor signoff, oncall assigned. blocking items: KMS approval pending.
infra-ron: KMS-1788 approved by KMS-ops with HSM origin and Decrypt scoped. merging infra PR now.
security-bot: infra PR merged. export job created id=EX-9001. pre-signed URL valid 3h from 2026-08-14T03:20:00Z. unwrap window 3h; snapshot scheduled to delete in 48h.
oncall-jane: performed MFA, downloaded snapshot, verified scrubs. audit logs show grant=authz#EX-9001, decrypt=crypto#EX-9001, download=net#EX-9001. scheduling deletion confirmation after 48h.
auditor-ali: audit trail validated. SALT usage confirmed. approving closure.
harper: done — triage team has the data. follow-ups: add an "incident ephemeral export" template to docs and add CI lint for broad SIEM permissions. Thanks all.
